snippet.title: Puppet War : FPS - New version 1.1 Teaser
snippet.description:
http://www.puppetwar.com  ★★★★★ New EPISODE 2 MASSIVE update is here!!! ★★★★★ New Ep.2 teaser: http://youtu.be/tIgrGg6m-L8

Loads of new content: 10 new WEAPONS like the FLAME THROWER & SNIPER RIFLE! 5 New MAPS ! New PUPPETS like the VAMPIRE and SOLDIER Puppets! BOSS fights! Special perks, UPGRADEABLE Weapons and more! 

THE EPIC WAR OF MAN VS PUPPETS CONTINUES!

from Twindigo.
Available now on the App-store!
http://itunes.apple.com/app/puppet-war-fps/id376049023?mt=8

NOW ALSO AVAILABLE FOR THE IPAD : Puppet War HD
http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/puppet-war-hd/id485290339?ls=1&mt=8

Puppet War:FPS (First Puppet Shooter) is a 3d fps game for the iPhone & iPad in which you play a janitor who has to battle evil puppets that want to take over the world! ..All this in a colorful kids-show tv studio with extremely lethal weapons!
